AboutPage.heroTitle: Built on Speed, Honesty & Complete Data Privacy
AboutPage.heroSubtitle: Headquartered at Sadashiv Peth, QuickFix was founded to free Pune residents from frustrating service center queues, dishonest quotes, and days without their phone.
AboutPage.storyTitle: The QuickFix Story: Born in Sadashiv Peth
AboutPage.storySubtitle: A mission to transform smartphone repair from a stressful hassle into a delightful 30-minute doorstep experience.
AboutPage.storyP1: In 2021, our founder Samadhan Patil noticed a glaring problem in Pune's electronics market: when a smartphone screen cracked or a battery degraded, customers were forced to navigate Pune traffic to crowded repair markets, surrender their phone for 5 to 7 days, and constantly worry about the privacy of their personal photos, messages, and bank apps.
AboutPage.storyP2: Samadhan asked a simple question: If essentials and food can reach your doorstep in minutes, why should you have to leave your phone at a distant shop? He launched QuickFix with a mobile precision workbench, serving homes across Sadashiv Peth and Kothrud. Today, QuickFix has grown into Pune's highest-rated network of certified doorstep mobile technicians.
AboutPage.storyP3: Every repair is carried out in front of your eyes on a sterile antistatic technician mat. You never hand over your unlock password, and you only pay after personally testing your repaired device.
AboutPage.pillarsTitle: The 4 Pillars of Our Doorstep Service
AboutPage.pillarsSubtitle: Our non-negotiable promises to every smartphone owner across Pune.
AboutPage.pillar1Desc: You never share your unlock PIN or format your phone. The repair is conducted in plain sight at your desk or coffee table.
AboutPage.pillar2Desc: Our master technicians arrive equipped with specialized precision tools to replace screens and batteries in 30 minutes flat.
AboutPage.pillar3Desc: We strictly use tested OEM-grade parts. If any part malfunctions within 90 days, we replace it free with zero hassle.
AboutPage.pillar4Desc: Upfront pricing with zero doorstep travel fees. If our technician is unable to resolve your issue on-site, you pay ₹0.
AboutPage.founderSubtitle: The technician's craft behind Pune's trusted repair service.
AboutPage.founderBio: With over a decade of hands-on expertise in micro-soldering, SMD rework, and smartphone hardware architecture, Samadhan built QuickFix on three principles: uncompromising part quality, transparent pricing, and unwavering customer respect.
AboutPage.founderQuote: Your smartphone carries your work, memories, and life. We treat every device with the exact care and privacy we would expect for our own.
AboutPage.zonesSubtitle: Stationed across 5 regional hubs for express 25 to 45 minute dispatch anywhere in the city.
AboutPage.ctaSubtitle: Book a certified master technician to your home or office anywhere in Pune in under 2 minutes.
